title: [Master]-Service Order created from Service Contract does not populate header dimensions until Dimensions action is opened
summary: Service orders created from service contracts now populate header dimensions automatically instead of requiring the Dimensions action to be opened first.
key_points: Fixed a bug where header dimensions were not applied to newly created service orders from contracts
The issue affected the Create Contract Service Orders report
Dimensions are now populated immediately when service orders are generated
Test coverage was expanded to verify the dimension population behavior
quote: Service Order created from Service Contract does not populate header dimensions until Dimensions action is opened
